label: Cereals containing gluten
notes: Wheat (such as spelt and khorasan wheat), rye, barley, oats or their hybridised strains.

label: Crustaceans
notes: Crabs, lobster, prawns, scampi, etc.

label: Peanuts
notes: Also known as groundnuts. Distinct from tree nuts.

label: Soya
notes: Soya beans, edamame, tofu, soy sauce.

label: Milk
notes: Cow, sheep, and goat milk protein. UK FIC legal requirement.

label: Tree nuts
notes: Almonds, hazelnuts, walnuts, cashews, pecan nuts, Brazil nuts, pistachio nuts, macadamia (or Queensland) nuts.

label: Celery
notes: Includes celery stalks, leaves, seeds and the root called celeriac.

label: Mustard
notes: Liquid mustard, mustard powder and mustard seeds.

label: Sesame
notes: Sesame seeds, tahini, hummous, sesame oil.

label: Sulphur dioxide / Sulphites
notes: Where added and at a level above 10mg/kg or 10mg/L in the finished product.

label: Lupin
notes: Lupin seeds and flour, sometimes found in certain types of bread, pastries, and pasta.

label: Molluscs
notes: Mussels, land snails, squid, whelks, oysters.

label: Lactose
notes: Distinct from milk allergy. Hard cheeses usually contain trace amounts, whereas soft dairy contains higher levels.

label: Alliums (Onion/Garlic)
notes: High-FODMAP triggers: onions, garlic, leeks, shallots.

label: Nightshades
notes: Tomatoes, potatoes, aubergines, peppers, chillies.

label: Meat
notes: All mammalian meat. Does not include poultry.

label: Poultry
notes: Chicken, turkey, duck.

label: Game
notes: Venison, rabbit, pheasant, etc.

label: Shellfish
notes: Dietary combination of Crustaceans and Molluscs.

label: Animal-derived
notes: Gelatine, honey, rennet, cochineal, isinglass. Excludes direct meat/fish/egg/dairy.
